observations.text: Splunk alert NodeNotReady fired for worker-1
kubernetes Service timeouts from worker-1 above baseline for 12 min
OutDiscards rising on cisco-sim-1 Gi1/0/13 for 6 polls

evidence.query: index=ocp sourcetype=kube:events reason IN (NodeNotReady, NodeReady) involvedObject.name=ocp-sim-worker earliest=-30m
evidence.finding: NotReady 09:20:41, Ready 09:21:27: 46 s, above the 40 s grace, below the 300 s eviction threshold

evidence.query: index=ocp sourcetype=kube:events involvedObject.name=ocp-sim-worker reason IN (Rebooted, Starting) earliest=-30m
evidence.finding: No Rebooted or Starting events: no reboot, no kubelet restart

evidence.query: index=ocp sourcetype=kube:container:svc-prober host=ocp-sim-worker "i/o timeout" earliest=-30m | timechart span=1m count
evidence.finding: API Service timeouts from worker-1 on 41% of probes in the last 15 min

evidence.query: SELECT DateTime, InDiscards, OutDiscards, InErrors, OutErrors FROM Orion.NPM.InterfaceErrors WHERE InterfaceID = 13 AND DateTime > ADDDATE('minute', -30, GETUTCDATE()) ORDER BY DateTime
evidence.finding: OutDiscards on Gi1/0/13 rising for 6 polls, still rising; InErrors and OutErrors flat

evidence.query: show platform hardware fed switch active qos queue stats interface Gi1/0/13
evidence.reason_for_probe: Per-queue drops are not polled by SolarWinds (needs_live in ocp-node-flap)

evidence.query: index=ocp sourcetype=kube:events namespace IN (openshift-kube-apiserver, openshift-etcd, kube-system) source_host=ocp-sim-worker reason IN (Killing, Started, BackOff, Unhealthy) earliest=-30m | stats count by involvedObject.name, reason
evidence.finding: No Killing or Started events: API server and etcd pods did not restart

evidence.query: index=ocp sourcetype=kube:events reason IN (TaintManagerEviction, Evicted, Preempted) earliest=-30m

correlations.text: worker-1 is fed by cisco-sim-1 Gi1/0/13; its API timeouts and the port's drops rose in the same 10 min

hypotheses.statement: Congestion on the node's switch path delays API traffic and lease renewals

llm_adjustment.reason: Queue drops and timeouts start within the same minute

hypotheses.statement: CPU or memory starvation on the node stalls the kubelet

conclusion.likely_cause: Congestion on cisco-sim-1 Gi1/0/13 delayed worker-1's API calls and lease renewals
conclusion.what_happened: worker-1 had a transient NotReady (node flap) for 46 s: above the 40 s grace period, below the 300 s eviction threshold. It did not reboot and the kubelet did not restart (no Rebooted or Starting events). No pods were evicted.

recommended_actions.step: Find top talkers towards worker-1 (NetFlow, or a SPAN capture by the network team)
recommended_actions.why: Queue 1 drops point at bursty traffic

recommended_actions.command: show platform hardware fed switch active qos queue stats interface Gi1/0/13

recommended_actions.step: Watch the node's lease renewals while drops continue
recommended_actions.why: A second gap over 40 s means another flap

escalation.reason: Single NotReady flap, recovered, congestion on Gi1/0/13 still present

probe_reasons: Per-queue drops are not polled by SolarWinds (needs_live in ocp-node-flap)
